candidates.concept: An adult astronomical instrument technician in a high-altitude observatory compares a crimson round narrowband filter cassette with a cyan square-edged cassette beside their spectrum cards; a precision spectral loupe pauses over the gap, red task light meets cool predawn window light, and the calibration slot remains empty.

An adult museum paper conservator at a raking-light table compares a feathered ivory tissue strip with a denser warm-gray strip against a torn map margin; fine tweezers pause between the materials while the repair area remains uncovered.

An adult ceramics restoration chemist in a UV-inspection studio compares a clear resin swatch with an amber-tinted swatch against a cracked celadon shard; a microbrush pauses above two separate mixing wells while the crack stays untreated.

An adult alpine field botanist inside a mobile lab compares two visibly different seed trays against matching herbarium sheets; forceps pause between the trays under a warm work lamp and blue storm light while neither sample enters the scanner.

safety_scope: unmistakably adult, non-graphic, occupational editorial photography
